title: Man who inherited £50m Cornwall estate after DNA test found guilty in pub fight
summary_full: Jordan Adlard-Rogers recently discovered he is the rightful heir to the Penrose Estate after a DNA test confirmed his lineage. However, his newfound status is marred by legal issues stemming from a wedding altercation where he punched another guest, causing severe injuries that required surgery. Although he claimed self-defense, a jury dismissed his argument, leaving his future uncertain as he awaits sentencing on December 11.
